assumptions: Approximate axial symmetry; axis at -25 degrees in the source raster and zero inclination to its plane. This is a modeling prior, not a measured orientation.
Crop removes only the publisher frame and caption. Original 800x525 bytes remain intact in the cache.
Four manually inspected point masks use local annular median attenuation, including the central star; bright nebular knots remain. This baseline does not claim complete NOX extraction.
RGB is display-stretched false color, not calibrated line intensity. Channels are solved independently on a 144x80 working image; tau refers to [0,1] values.
Single-image depth is underdetermined. No measured gas density, physical extent, distance, inclination or stellar catalogue is inferred.
The existing PolyCSS shared-opacity slab renderer approximates the paper's additive emission; brightness can depend on direction and must be inspected separately.

provenance.method: Wenger, Lorenz & Magnor 2013, equations 1–7; independent TypeScript implementation
